data.body: Fix complete. Implementation: (1) ticket-lib.sh resolve_ticket_id Step 2 and Step 5 delegate to ticket-alias-resolve.py --mode=8hex|prefix with param-expansion bash fallback; (2) ticket-lib-api.sh _ticketlib_resolve_short_id (the hot path for dso ticket show short) same delegation, caught by orchestrator anti-pattern sweep after initial sub-agent missed it; (3) ticket-exists.sh and ticket-lib.sh:1975 param expansion only. ticket-alias-resolve.py extended with --mode={alias|8hex|prefix} dispatch. Empirical: 8-hex 806s->286ms (~2800x), prefix 71s->1.5s, alias 2.37s->1.4s, full 16-hex baseline unchanged. All 170 targeted resolver tests pass.
